sections.heading: Controls
rows: Space, then Space again in the air (hold to climb)

sections.heading: Saving
sections.text: Progress saves automatically to the selected adventure. Rings, deliveries, treasures, books, bosses and Elements of Harmony experience sync to your Ponyhaven profile. Terrain damage resets when a solo or hosted world opens.

sections.heading: Every pony can fly
sections.text: Jump, release, then jump again in the air to fly. Landing or entering water ends flight.

sections.heading: Experience
sections.text: Each Element has its own experience bar, shown in the quest journal (Tab) and on the Equestria page. Level 2 needs 300 experience, and each level after needs 150 more. Every new level earns one very rare card for your collection.

sections.heading: The six Elements
rows: Telling the truth kindly, and helping others hear it.
Noticing how others feel and caring for them gently.
Bringing joy that includes everypony, never at their expense.
Giving time, effort and credit freely.
Standing by friends, especially when it is hard.
Bringing friends together so their strengths become one.

sections.heading: Experience sources
rows: 40 to its first Element, 20 to its second, plus 30 (heartfelt choice) or 15 to the Element of your choice

sections.heading: How they work
sections.text: Every few minutes a town pony needs urgent help. A big pink heart marks the way. Hear the troubled pony out, hear the other side, find two clues, discover the twist, then choose how to help. Every choice resolves the emergency; the one that best honours the twist earns the most experience. Only one emergency is active at a time, and you can give one up from the journal: another appears after a short while. Each resolution also earns 300 bits.

sections.heading: Kinds of emergency
rows: Two friends have fallen out because one believes the other betrayed them.
The accused pony may have broken a promise for a good reason.
Two ponies have conflicting obligations and neither can keep theirs without disappointing the other.
There may be no answer that satisfies everypony completely.
A pony is avoided because others think they are dangerous, strange or untrustworthy.
The feared pony might really be causing trouble, but unintentionally.
A pony is overwhelmed by responsibility or perfectionism and pushes others away.
Simply doing their work for them can reinforce the problem.
A magical effect amplifies jealousy, dishonesty, anger or suspicion.
Removing the magic does not undo the hurtful things that were said.
The excluded pony may want a different kind of friendship, or more independence.

sections.heading: Quest chains
sections.text: Town ponies with a gold ! offer quest chains of two to four deliveries. Each delivered step earns 150 bits and Element experience. Ponies talk in speech bubbles; the journal keeps recent conversations.

sections.heading: Rings and treasure
sections.text: Rings appear each day and give 10 bits each. 50 treasure chests each give one rare card or a new pet, and refill 24 hours after opening.

sections.heading: The seven books
sections.text: Seven unique floating spellbooks rest at fixed, widely scattered places, marked in purple on the world map. Press 1–7 to equip a collected book; it replaces both mouse attacks.

sections.heading: Bosses
sections.text: Giant world bosses use telegraphed attacks. Defeating one adds it to your virtual pets.

sections.heading: Getting around
sections.text: Press I for the world map and travel between towns. Teleporters join distant areas. Town ponies keep simple daily routines and stand still when you come to talk.
